_about: SITE-R register — every spck.dev site requirement as an enforceable row (design spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-09-website-ia-redesign-design.md). ADD-ONLY: removing or weakening a row requires a reasoned entry in site_requirements_retired.json; enforced by `site_gates.py tdd` against git HEAD. Test id conventions: 'site_smoke:<name>' = a test block tagged `// SITE-R-xxx` in tests/web/browser/site_smoke.mjs; 'gate:<mode>' = a site_gates.py mode; 'responsive_smoke' = the existing tests/web/browser/responsive_smoke.mjs suite. The tdd gate is GREEN only at 100% (every row has >=1 existing test, no orphan test tags).

requirements.requirement: Unified nav byte-identical on all 6 pages (spck · Merchants /check · Agents /agent · Coverage /coverage · Docs /docs · GitHub↗); contains no /tool link
No 'Launch Tool' text anywhere on the site
Exactly one .btn-primary above the fold per page
/check depth ladder sections in DOM order instant → cli → ci (data-ladder-step markers)
Unofficial-disclaimer sentence on every page (independent + unofficial + not affiliated + the official suite is authoritative)
OG + Twitter share meta on every page
CLASS-AUTO numbers are data-rendered: any number that exists in coverage/agent-coverage JSON carries data-live and its static fallback text equals the live JSON value at gate time
No unregistered factual claims: every claim candidate is LIVE-bound (data-live) or registered in public/site_claims.json with evidence and an unexpired review_by
Voice banned patterns absent (superlatives, achievement framing, 'certified'/'endorsed', unverifiable stats, third-party names outside the data-attribution block)
/tool → /check and /guide → /docs 301 redirects present in public/_redirects; no page links to /tool or /guide
Security: /* headers include nosniff, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, CSP default-src 'self'; no un-esc()'d innerHTML/document.write/insertAdjacentHTML sinks; no external script/style/font origins
Sandbox loads >= 6 demo cases
Pages render meaningfully if the coverage JSON fetch fails (graceful degradation, no blank main)
Zero console errors on load of every page
No horizontal overflow at 320px (and 375px) on every page
Analytics beacons: home_view on /, page_view beacons on /check and /docs
Product-manifest change (merchant/agent check counts, defect count, spec versions) forces a site claims review before the lane goes green
Hook-first homepage: badge + H1 hook + exactly two hero CTAs (/check, /agent) above the fold

Shared design system: every page links /site.css and never redefines a shared component (.site-nav/.site-footer/.btn-primary/.btn-secondary/.btn-ghost) in inline <style> — the look is single-sourced so the nav/footer/buttons cannot re-theme per page

Admin access control: every /api/admin/* route rejects unauthenticated requests (401/403) and authenticated non-admin sessions (403); the admin allowlist is manageable ONLY by a super-admin (POST/DELETE /api/admin/admins); a super-admin can never be removed or demoted via the API; management actions are audit-logged

Admin page (public/admin.html): carries noindex,nofollow; is linked from no nav or public page; uses the standard shell (site.css, byte-identical nav, disclaimer footer); renders every metric from runtime API responses with no static numeric claims in markup

Page-view funnel: home/check/docs/coverage view and return beacon events are allow-listed in /api/track (a sent event must not be silently dropped) and each of those pages sends its view/return beacon

Save-report flow: a completed instant check offers an email+OTP save; saving requires an authenticated session (401 otherwise); the saved report is retrievable by its owner and walled from other users; each save records the store domain on the user (email-to-domain mapping) and attempts a best-effort report email that never blocks the save; the report_saved conversion beacon is allow-listed
Admin dashboard reflects the current product: the users listing exposes each user's recorded store domains (the email-to-domain lead mapping) and the funnel pane counts report_saved conversions

Public opt-in conformance badge: GET /api/badge/<reportId>.svg serves an SVG derived from the saved report's summary (grade, pass/total, date) with no authentication — the unguessable report id is shared only by its owner embedding the badge. Missing/expired ids return a 200 'unknown' badge so embedded images never break, every interpolated value is XML-escaped, and responses are publicly cacheable.

Published check register: every spec requirement the suite covers (status=check in coverage.json) has a generated page under /checks/<ID> showing the requirement text, RFC-2119 keyword, versions, testability, and a citation deep-linked to the SHA-pinned spec source; /checks/ indexes them all; /rubric explains how verdicts are graded. Pages are generated deterministically from coverage.json (the same source as /coverage) and a gate regenerates and byte-compares so they can never drift from the product.

Preview badge honesty: GET /api/badge?server=<url> (functions/api/badge.js) renders the discovery + profile-structure PREVIEW as `preview N/M` (N passed of M preview checks) and never the word "conformant" for any preview outcome — four structural checks are not a conformance verdict (PLAN-v3 §2.18, D5-20).

Coverage-page honesty sentences are registered claims rendered verbatim: the 2026-08-25 evidence-ceiling sentence is CLAIM-COV-002 (data-driven — renders only while the version's live-wire count is 0) and the 2026-04-08 tab carries the CLAIM-COV-003 footnote naming the measured commit (a2d8bf0b) and the 2026-09-09 tag re-point (ucp#813); the retired sentence "no independently-authored 08-25 implementation exists" never renders (PLAN-v3 §2.18, D5-02).

Audit scope is every hand-authored page under public/** recursively (sub-directories such as state-of-ucp/ included); only generated trees/pages (checks/, known-issues.html) are excluded because their own byte-compare gates hold them. A planted page under a sub-directory carrying an unregistered claim reds `claims` (kill-tested by conformance/ci/validate_site_gates.py); the launch page's claims are registered LAU-001..007 (PLAN-v3 §2.18, D5-10).

Non-page copy is held to the page bar: every advertised count in README.md, conformance/ci/README.md, packaging/README.md, hand-authored docs/*.md and functions/**/*.js equals the live product value (MCheck count, agent checks/defects, live-wire) or is a registered dated row in conformance/web/doc_claims.json; registered doc claims (must_match / must_not_match / bind) still hold; every gate row in ci/README names a gate in run_suite.py; the coverage gate's copy-freshness scope includes functions/**/*.js and ci/README (PLAN-v3 §2.18, D5-01).

Publication state is rule R-a, mirrored from coverage.json fields only: live ⇔ register ∧ CHECK+EXEMPT>0 ∧ zero testable/needs-receiver/needs-oauth GAP; converting ⇔ register ∧ CHECK+EXEMPT>0 ∧ any such GAP; building ⇔ register ∧ 0/0; unregistered otherwise. site-freshness reds on any state that disagrees with its own export; supported versions (manifest.versions) = live only; the coverage page renders a `converting` note ("checks are landing; N of M testable-tier MUSTs still open; never blended"), the state word on each tab, and the data-driven "converting — no further work planned; N webhook-receiver rows ungraded" line (CLAIM-COV-005) on legacy versions (PLAN-v3 §2.18, decision 25, D5-03).

The claims register's product-derived blocks (manifest: merchant/agent counts + supported versions; evidence.per_version: the evidence-class split) are GENERATED by conformance/web/sync_site_claims.py from the engine and byte-compared by `--check` (run_suite gate site-claims-sync, preflight, deploy.sh step 2); the writer never rewrites `reviewed`, `review_by`, claim text or evidence prose (kill-tested in validate_site_gates.py). Registry hygiene: every REG claim is found on its page (`claims --orphans` → 0) or sits in `retired_claims` with a reason (PLAN-v3 §2.18, D5-05).

KNOWN ISSUES is one path: conformance/ci/known_issues.json (validated by validate_known_issues.py) is the only source of public/known-issues.json, public/known-issues.html and the State-of-UCP tracker's known-issues counts. The page and JSON are GENERATED by conformance/web/gen_known_issues.py (deterministic; byte-compared by site_gates.py checkdocs and by `gen_known_issues.py --check`); every row is registered as site claim KI-<id> (text = symptom, review_by = the row's clock) and the claims block is kept in sync by the same generator; a refuted row is refused by the validator before anything renders; the tracker section binds every count with data-live to known-issues.json (a hand-typed count reds site-claims); site-freshness reds when any published row's re_verified is older than 30 days (PLAN-v3 §2.13, D5-12).

The instant check (/api/conformance, /check) and the badge run PREVIEW checks mapped 1:1 to engine checks by the committed, add-only id map conformance/web/preview_parity.json (js id -> engine ids, requirement ids per version, counted flag, stage): every rendered row carries its engine twin(s) and requirement ids for the profile's version (no hard-coded citations in prose), `summary` and the badge's N/M count only `counted` ids (discovery.content_type is report-only), 01-11 profiles are graded in their own shape, and the parity gate conformance/ci/preview_parity.py grades a FROZEN capture set (goldens, controlled fixtures, synthetic mutants) on both sides against the expected-verdict file, refusing an unmapped id, an expired tolerated divergence or any verdict drift (PLAN-v3 §2.18, D5-11).
